title: TEST DRIVE ISLAND
description: The vehicle bay now lets players test premium mounts on a private stunt island before buying, complete with timed jumps, destructible billboards, and one suspiciously forgiving landing ramp.
consequence: Players finally understand what the expensive tires are for. The showroom stops speaking in thumbnails.

title: COMMUNAL SEED LIBRARY
description: The village market now lets players borrow seasonal seeds from a shared library, grow the crop once, and return a portion of the harvest instead of buying the starter pack.
consequence: The farm gets friendlier. The checkout flow discovers the political dangers of vegetables.

title: BONFIRE REVIVE OFFER
description: Failed extraction runs now pause at the nearest bonfire with a limited revive offer, letting players keep their loot if they buy back in before the ashes settle.
consequence: Death becomes less final. The bonfire learns when to clear its throat.

title: LOADOUT RECEIPT REVIEW
description: Every run now opens with a receipt-style audit of equipped weapons, card sleeves, ammo skins, and expired trial boosts before the player can ready up.
consequence: The build screen becomes legally thorough. The receipt arrives before the fantasy.
